newsitem.title: CUBA: British man seeks Cuban "young ladies" - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: British man seeks Cuban "young ladies" - newspaper.

text.p: The advertisement was similar to many seen in a variety of publications around the world:

"English businessman, wealthy and very generous, seeks thin young ladies who speak English or want to learn it to accompany him on travels in Caribbean and Europe. Send photos and details to Mr. Thompson."
The only problem was that the ad was sent by electronic mail for placement in the Cuban weekly Communist Party youth paper Juventud Rebelde. It got what the editor termed an "unprintable" response.
The paper ran an article Sunday denouncing the ad, saying the anonymous Mr. Thompson apparently did not realise that "there are places in this world where the souls of children are not for sale."
Prostitution, banned in Cuba after President Fidel Castro's 1959 revolution, has re-emerged in the past five years amid economic crisis and an increase in foreign tourists and businessmen.
